grammar.pattern: 多 / 多么 / 好 / 更 / 十分 / 特别 / 挺 / 有（一）点儿
grammar.purpose: Express degree and separate a complaint from a quantity
grammar.explanation: 多安静啊、多么安静啊 and 好亮啊 can express an exclamation. 更 requires a comparison understood from context; 十分、特别、挺 indicate degree, with 挺…的 common in conversation. 有点儿/有一点儿 before an adjective often expresses a slight unwelcome state: 有点儿吵. In 小一点儿, 一点儿 follows the adjective and requests a change; it is not the same order or meaning as 有点儿小. Do not treat 好 here as the adjective good: 好亮 means so bright, not good brightness.

examples.zh: 多安静啊！多么安静啊！这里好亮啊！
examples.py: duō ān jìng a ! duō me ān jìng a ! zhè lǐ hǎo liàng a !
examples.en: How quiet! How quiet it is! It is so bright here!

examples.zh: 这里更安静，十分舒服，特别适合读书，挺好的。
examples.py: zhè lǐ gèng ān jìng , shí fēn shū fú , tè bié shì hé dú shū , tǐng hǎo de .
examples.en: It is quieter here, very comfortable, especially suitable for reading, and quite good.

examples.zh: 门口有一点儿吵，请把音量调小一点儿。
examples.py: mén kǒu yǒu yì diǎnr chǎo , qǐng bǎ yīn liàng diào xiǎo yì diǎn ér .
examples.en: It is a little noisy at the entrance; please turn the volume down a little.

commonMistakes.why: For a requested reduction, put 一点儿 after 小 and supply the adjustment verb.

grammar.pattern: 比 + difference / 比 + 更还 / 不如 / 有…这么那么
grammar.purpose: Keep a quantified difference separate from a degree judgment
grammar.explanation: A比B贵十块 gives a ten-yuan difference, not A’s total price. A比B更安静 and A比B还安静 emphasize the comparison. A不如B安静 says A is less quiet; A不如B can give a broader judgment. A有B这么安静吗 asks whether A reaches B’s degree. Without measurement, say 有点儿响 rather than inventing decibels. 温度比…低三度 concerns temperature, not three degrees of emotional comfort.

dialogue.title: Move farther from the speaker
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the chosen seats, price and what is only a judgment.

lines.zh: 好久没见！你明天也有空儿吗？
lines.py: hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn ! nǐ míng tiān yě yǒu kòngr ma ?
lines.en: Long time no see! Are you free tomorrow too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 明天还不知道。今天门口有一点儿响，我们先看里面吧。
lines.py: míng tiān hái bù zhī dào . jīn tiān mén kǒu yǒu yì diǎnr xiǎng , wǒ men xiān kàn lǐ miàn ba .
lines.en: I do not know about tomorrow yet. The entrance is a little loud today; let us check inside first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 里面好多座位，没满。这里比门口更安静。
lines.py: lǐ miàn hǎo duō zuò wèi , méi mǎn . zhè lǐ bǐ mén kǒu gèng ān jìng .
lines.en: There are many seats inside, not all occupied. It is quieter than the entrance.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 挺舒服的，但灯十分亮，我不太喜欢。
lines.py: tǐng shū fú de , dàn dēng shí fēn liàng , wǒ bù tài xǐ huān .
lines.en: Quite comfortable, but the lights are very bright; I do not particularly like that.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 后面没有这么亮，也离音箱更远。
lines.py: hòu miàn méi yǒu zhè me liàng , yě lí yīn xiāng gèng yuǎn .
lines.en: It is not this bright farther back, and it is farther from the speaker.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，那边读书的人不少，我们小声说。
lines.py: hǎo , nà biān dú shū de rén bù shǎo , wǒ men xiǎo shēng shuō .
lines.en: Good. Quite a few people are reading there; let us speak quietly.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 门口四十，里面五十，贵十块。费用不超过五十，行吗？
lines.py: mén kǒu sì shí , lǐ miàn wǔ shí , guì shí kuài . fèi yòng bù chāo guò wǔ shí , xíng ma ?
lines.en: The entrance is forty and inside fifty, ten more. At most fifty, okay?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行。门口不如里面安静，十块是差价，不是全部。
lines.py: xíng . mén kǒu bù rú lǐ miàn ān jìng , shí kuài shì chà jià , bù shì quán bù .
lines.en: Okay. The entrance is not as quiet as inside. Ten is the difference, not the total.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 两边温度不同，里面比门口低三度。
lines.py: liǎng biān wēn dù bù tóng , lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu dī sān dù .
lines.en: The temperatures differ; inside is three degrees lower than the entrance.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 但我没量声音，不能说低了多少分贝。只觉得这里更合适。
lines.py: dàn wǒ méi liáng shēng yīn , bù néng shuō dī le duō shao fēn bèi . zhǐ jué de zhè lǐ gèng hé shì .
lines.en: But I did not measure the sound; I cannot say how many decibels lower it is. I only feel it is more suitable.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 音箱的声音有点儿难听，要不要再大声说？
lines.py: yīn xiāng de shēng yīn yǒu diǎn ér nán tīng , yào bù yào zài dà shēng shuō ?
lines.en: The speaker sounds a little unpleasant. Should we speak louder?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不用大声。我听得见，音量小一点点就好。
lines.py: bù yòng dà shēng . wǒ tīng dé jiàn , yīn liàng xiǎo yì diǎn diǎn jiù hǎo .
lines.en: No need to speak loudly. I can hear; just lower the volume a tiny bit.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Inside, farther back from the speaker

A place known to cost ten yuan in total

reading.title: A comfort note
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read to separate price, measured temperature and personal comfort.

lines.zh: 我和朋友好久没见。今天见面，明天有没有空儿还不知道。
lines.py: wǒ hé péng you hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn . jīn tiān jiàn miàn , míng tiān yǒu méi yǒu kòngr hái bù zhī dào .
lines.en: My friend and I have not met for a long time. We meet today; we do not yet know whether tomorrow is free.

lines.zh: 门口有一点儿响，也不够安静。里面更安静，座位还没满。
lines.py: mén kǒu yǒu yì diǎnr xiǎng , yě bù gòu ān jìng . lǐ miàn gèng ān jìng , zuò wèi hái méi mǎn .
lines.en: The entrance is a little loud and not quiet enough. Inside is quieter, and seats are still available.

lines.zh: 里面有好多座位，挺舒服的。前面的灯十分亮，我不太喜欢，所以选后面。
lines.py: lǐ miàn yǒu hǎo duō zuò wèi , tǐng shū fú de . qián miàn de dēng shí fēn liàng , wǒ bù tài xǐ huān , suǒ yǐ xuǎn hòu miàn .
lines.en: Inside has many seats and is quite comfortable. The front lights are very bright and I do not particularly like them, so we choose farther back.

lines.zh: 后面离音箱远，灯也没有前面这么亮。有人读书，我们就小声说。
lines.py: hòu miàn lí yīn xiāng yuǎn , dēng yě méi yǒu qián miàn zhè me liàng . yǒu rén dú shū , wǒ men jiù xiǎo shēng shuō .
lines.en: Farther back is away from the speaker, and the lights are not as bright as at the front. People are reading, so we speak quietly.

lines.zh: 门口四十，里面五十。里面比门口贵十块，但费用没有超过五十。
lines.py: mén kǒu sì shí , lǐ miàn wǔ shí . lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu guì shí kuài , dàn fèi yòng méi yǒu chāo guò wǔ shí .
lines.en: The entrance costs forty and inside fifty. Inside is ten more, but the cost does not exceed fifty.

lines.zh: 门口不如里面安静。这是我们的感受，不是测出来的声音数字。
lines.py: mén kǒu bù rú lǐ miàn ān jìng . zhè shì wǒ men de gǎn shòu , bù shì cè chū lái de shēng yīn shù zì .
lines.en: The entrance is not as quiet as inside. This is our impression, not a measured sound figure.

lines.zh: 温度表显示，里面比门口低三度。这个三度说的是温度，不是音量。
lines.py: wēn dù biǎo xiǎn shì , lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu dī sān dù . zhè gè sān dù shuō de shì wēn dù , bù shì yīn liàng .
lines.en: The thermometer shows that inside is three degrees lower than the entrance. These three degrees refer to temperature, not volume.

lines.zh: 音箱有点儿难听，不过不用大声说。音量小一点点就好，我们也没有要求别人离开。
lines.py: yīn xiāng yǒu diǎn ér nán tīng , bù guò bù yòng dà shēng shuō . yīn liàng xiǎo yì diǎn diǎn jiù hǎo , wǒ men yě méi yǒu yāo qiú bié ren lí kāi .
lines.en: The speaker sounds a little unpleasant, but there is no need to speak loudly. A tiny reduction in volume is enough; we do not ask anyone to leave.
